Update only the isolated test copy with the current app version, including export/import. In that copy, use only ganesha.tasks.test; do not read, write or remove ganesha.tasks.v1. Then simulate a write failure when confirming a valid import. Preserve the previous list and data, show an error and do not claim replacement succeeded. Explain how to remove the rehearsal.
